Commentary.Commentary: Mohammad Saifuddin was the pick of the bowlers for the hosts. He took three wickets and gave away just 45 runs. He was brought on to take wickets whenever Bangladesh wanted and he did that. Rahman was economical too getting a scalp while Mortaza who went for runs in the start came back strongly. So, the bowlers have done what they could and have restricted Zimbabwe to a decent total which the Bangladeshi players would fancy. Would they chase it down or will Zimbabwe level the series? Join us in a while for the chase.

A good comeback from Bangladesh after Zimbabwe looked like they would cross the 280-run mark. The visitors lost an early wicket of their skipper but Taylor stitched two 50+ partnerships with Zhuwao and then Sean Williams. Brendan got to his fifty but his partners fell short. Raza then got a few handy stands lower down the order but Zimbabwe lost their way later on once he feel, just short of a 50. They tried one too many shots but kept losing wickets. In the end, they couldn't even cross the 205-run mark.
Short ball on middle and leg, Mavuta goes for the pull and gets it past square leg for a couple of runs. ZIMBABWE END WITH 246/7 after 50 overs.
Tiripano has played it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.

NOT OUT! The decision has been overturned. Saifuddin goes short again down leg, Mavuta pulls it fine towards fine leg. Rahman dives low and takes the catch. He is in celebration and thinks he has got his man. The umpire makes Brandon wait and take it up. Replay shows us that Rahman didn't have his hands below the ball. The batsmen cross.
Final 3 balls to go, how many more can Zimbabwe score?
OUT! But the umpire has made the batsman wait to see if it is a clean catch. The soft signal is out.
Short again on middle and leg, Mavuta pulls it through square leg for a brace.
Great yorker. In line of the stumps, Tiripano digs it to the off side to get to the other end.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. They pick up a single.
Outside off, left alone.
Short ball outside off, Tiripano looks to pull it away but cannot make contact.

Bye. Fuller ball outside off, Mavuta looks to paddle it but at the last minute tries to guide it past the keeper. He couldn't get bat to ball and the keeper too couldn't hold onto ball. They steal a bye as the ball rolls to third man.
Full and down leg, flicked through mid-wicket for one.
Cutter outside off, Tiripano cannot get it past cover-point.
Length ball outside off, Tiripano cuts it to point.
BV works it down the leg side through mid-wicket. Two runs added to the total.

OUT! Another one bites the dust. Zimbabwe in the process to score big runs towards the end are losing quick wickets. Slower short ball outside off, Elton stands tall and looks to cut it above point. Does so but finds Nazmul in the deep.
On-drive through mid on for one.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. They pick up a single.

NOT OUT! Umpire's call. The original decision stays. Length ball on middle, Mavuta comes ahead and looks to turn it to the on side but misses his shot. Gets rapped in front and the players appeal. Nothing from the umpire. Bangladesh opt for a review but the replay show us that Mavuta was over 3m down the pitch. Review retained.
An LBW review has been taken up.
Slower ball down leg, Mavuta misses his flick to get hit on the pads.
Length ball on middle and leg, Elton closes the bat face early as the ball lops over cover-point getting a leading edge. They manage to come back for the second.
Another slower ball cutter outside off, Elton swings and misses.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Cutter outside off, EC cuts it to point.
Brandon Mavuta is the new man in.

OUT! Moor holes out! Full and outside off, Moor stays inside the crease and extends his arms. The ball goes high but doesn't have enough distance. Mehidy Hasan gets under it and takes a very good catch.
Full outside of, driven to covers.
Three dots to end an excellent over. 2 runs and a big wicket from it. It is on a length around off, Chigumbura tries to defend but gets an inside on his pads.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Fuller in length on off, Chugumbura strokes it to mid off.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! A timely wicket for Bangladesh. The two had started to break free but the Bangladeshi skipper has struck. He bowls it on a length around off, Raza tries to guide it down to third man. The ball takes the outside edge and goes low towards Rahim. He takes a good catch. Raza walks back and now Bangladesh will look to restrict Zimbabwe under 280.

DROPPED! The fielder actually threw it back in as he felt he was too close to the ropes. A big error in judgement there. A shorter in length delivery around middle, Moor goes for the pull. He connects well but the placement is not that great. It goes uppishly towards deep square leg. Mithun there runs to his right, he seems to have taken it but is not sure how close he is to the boundary, so he throws it back into play. The realizes that he was a long way away. A missed opportunity there and that too of a man who is striking it well out there. How costly will prove? The batsman take a run.
Slower ball on off, Raza hits it down to long on for a run.
Played to mid wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
A full toss on the pads, Raza flicks it in the gap in the mid-wicket region and takes two.
Another slower ball on off, Moor taps it towards covers and takes a quick run.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside.
FOUR! Stand and deliver! A length ball around off, Moor thumps it back past the bowler and there is no stopping those. Runs have started to flow now.
Fuller in length on off, Moor times it through mid on for a couple.
Saifuddin is back on.
No, they can't! Good change of pace by Mortaza. Moor is early into his shot He gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls towards the off side and the batters take a run.

FOUR! Powerful hit that! Full and on off, Moor slams it through mid off and the ball races away. This is turning out to be a good over for Zimbabwe. One more ball to go, can they finish it with a boundary?
Does the right thing now, the ball was not there to be hit so he works it around the corner and takes a run.
SIX! All the way! Once again it is early in the over. Raza picks the slower one, walks down the track and lofts it over the long off fence. Now they need to make this count.
Good length on off, Raza times it to covers.
Slower ball on the pads, the batsman works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Mashrafe Mortaza is back on.
Make that 4! Brilliant comeback from the bowler after being hit for a maximum early in the over. Floats it up on off, Raza finds cover with his drive.
Three dots in a row! A yorker on middle, Raza jams it out.
Two consecutive dots after the biggie. This is what they should avoid. Rotation of strike is so important after getting a boundary. Tossed up on off, stroked to covers.
Uses his feet again but does not get to the pitch of it. Blocks it out.
SIX! BANG! Much-needed. Raza is nimble on his feet, gets to the pitch of it and smashes it over long off for a biggie. They need to continue if the want to reach the 300-run mark.
Fires it on off, Raza pushes it to covers. A dot to end the last over, a dot to begin this one.
Lovely bowling! A slower yorker on off, Moor mistimes it back to the bowler. Just three from the over. Zimbabwe need to step on the gas now.
On a length and around off, kept out.
Very full on the pads, the batsman flicks it through backward square leg for a couple.
Cutter on the pads, it is worked through square leg for a run.
On middle, Raza works it to mid on. So runs are difficult to come by now.
On off, kept out.
Flatter on off, pushed back to the bowler.

In the air... but safe! The big shot was coming but luckily for Raza his miscue does not go to hand. This is tossed up on off, Raza tries to go downtown. He gets it off the outer half towards sweeper cover who comes running in. It bounces in front of him. He misfields and the batsmen take a run.
Flighted ball and Raza is once again happy to block it out. 3 dots after the brace on the first ball.
Tossed up on off, Raza keeps it out.
Tosses it on the stumps, the batsman defends it.
Dances down the track and flicks it through square leg for a couple.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Now a maximum of 5 fielders can be placed outside the circle.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They pick up a single.
Cutter outside off, Raza swings and misses.
Good length outside off, Moor guides it through point for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. The batsmen have run through for a single.
BEATEN! How often have we seen Rahman beat the outside edge in that manner. On a length and around off, it pitches and shapes away. Raza tries to cut but misses.
On middle, kept out.
Moor is happy to block it out. Loopy ball around off, Moor covers his stumps and bunts it out.
Tossed up ball around off, hit to covers.

NOT OUT! Big inside edge. Loopy ball on off, Moor looks to play it to the off side but gets hit on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Moor straightaway takes it up. Replays show us that thee was an inside edge onto his pads.
An LBW referral is taken up. Inside edge?
Full on off, kept out.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Raza works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Peter Moor walks out to bat.

OUT! No fifty for Wlliams. Short and wide outside off, Sean gives room and looks to cut it to the off side. Gets a thick edge which is taken by the keeper. Saifuddin takes another wicket and a well played innings comes to an end.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. One run added to the total.
Full and outside off, driven to mid off and quickly gets to the other end. A direct hit would have been close.
Length outside off, hit to the off side.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Length ball outside off, punched to the off side for one.
Ball hits the batsman low on the pads. One run added to the total. Leg byes signalled by the umpire
Raza dances down the track but decides to defend it.
Williams plays a sweep shot. One run added to the total.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to short third man.
Short ball outside off, punched through covers for a run.
Loopy ball on off, kept out.
Cuts it towards point and will retain strike for the next over.
Easy. Another punch towards mid off to rotate strike.
Lands this on off, driven through cover-point to change ends.
Full on middle and leg, hit to mid on for nothing.
Slower ball on off, Raza cuts it to point.
Full on leg, turned around the corner for one.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Nicely done. Full and in line of the stumps, Williams reverse sweeps it fine towards fine leg for a boundary.
On off, hit through mid off for a single.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short ball on off, punched off the back foot to the off side for one.
Full on middle and leg, on-drive to mid on for one.
Raza opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
FOUR! Short ball outside off, it spins into Raza who cuts it through mid off for another boundary.
FOUR! Full toss outside off, Raza steps out and slaps it over mid-wicket for a one-bounce boundary.
Driven through the covers by Raza. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Full and around off, driven through mid off for one.
Drinks!
Flatter on the pads, Raza misses his flick to get hit on the pads. The players appeal but nothing from the umpire.
On middle, defended.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
FOUR! Poor ball and it has been put away. Short and outside off, Raza slaps it through covers and the ball races away.
The arm ball on the pads, the batter tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal but it is not given. Going down leg.
On middle, blocked out.
Works it with the turn around the corner for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Strokes it through covers for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Shorter outside off, Raza punches it through covers for a run.
Eased down to long on for a run.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.

NOT OUT! Full on the pads, flicked away towards square leg. The players go for a quick run and make it. The fielder there collects the ball and throws it at the keeper's end. Rahim takes off the bails and the umpire goes upstairs. Replays show that the batsman makes it in time.
A run out appeal is taken up.
Full on the pads, Raza misses his flick to get hit on the pads.
In line of the stumps, Raza comes forward to bunt it down. The players appeal but SR was way down the pitch.
Williams works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Full on off, kept out.
Raza has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Sikandar Raza is the new man in.

OUT! A needless shot from Taylor and it brings his end. He just hits a beautiful inside-out shot and now tries to reverse sweep one. Off spinner on middle and leg, Taylor looks to reverse sweep it but cannot make contact. Gets hit on his pad, the players appeal and the umpire is quick to give it out. Taylor doesn't review it as he knew it wouldn't save him. The partnership of 77 is finally broken and a much needed wicket for the hosts.
FOUR! Inside-out! Loopy ball on off, Taylor gives room and lofts it over covers for a boundary.
Williams flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Mahmudullah is called onto bowl.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Full on the pads, flicked away to square leg off his pads.
SW drives this to the covers.
Loopy ball on middle and leg, driven to long off to change ends.
Darts this quick on off, hit back to the bowler.
Short ball on leg, flicked towards deep square leg. The batsmen jog to complete the run.
Short ball again, Williams pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Full on off, hit back to the bowler.
FOUR! What a hit. Short ball outside off, Williams stands tall and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full outside off, cut to the off side.
Short ball over the stumps, Taylor guides it towards third man for one.
Length ball in line of the stumps, Taylor hops and plays in into the ground.
Loopy ball on off, Williams bunts it down.
Full on the pads, flicked through square leg for a single.
On off, punched through mid-wicket to rotate strike.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman to the off side. They pick up a single.
Loopy ball on off, kept away by Taylor coming down the track.
FOUR! Knew exactly what he is doing and gets the desired result. Full and outside off, Taylor gets low and sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Eased through mid off for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The Fizz changes the angle and Taylor uses that angle and flicks it to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Up and over! Taylor walks down the track and little and makes the slower delivery into a half volley. He once again with a straight bat, lofts it over the bowler's head. The timing is not that good but good enough to clear mid off and cross the fence.
Slightly shorter and outside off, the ball is slapped through covers for a run.
On the pads, the batter works it through square leg and takes a single.
So just the one over for the left-arm spinner as Mustafizur Rahman is back.
Shuffles across and flicks it down to long on for a single.
On middle, Taylor defends it straight back towards the bowler. It is so straight that it hits the stumps at the other end.

50-run stand is up between the two with that single. A good partnership. However, the two hold the key. They need to bat long if Zimbabwe are to post a good first innings score here. It is the slower ball on the pads, Williams works it fine on the leg side for a run.
Slaps this through covers and a run is taken. 49 is the stand between the two.
Fuller in length on middle, SW with the angle works it through square leg for a run. This is good partnership here for Zimbabwe.
Angles it on the pads, Williams tries to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
The batsman has been struck on the pads as he looked to play that off the front foot.
A low full toss on the pads, Williams sweeps it through square leg for a run.

Floats it up on middle, Taylor tries to defend for the turn. Maybe keeping the dismissal of the last match in mind  he played that way. There was no turn, the ball goes off the inside edge towards square leg for a run.
Williams strokes this through mid on and changes strike.
Good batting this, got a boundary of the last ball and now eases this down through mid on for a run.
FOUR! Excellent stuff! Great technique! Welcome into the attack Islam. It is tossed up around off, Taylor makes room, goes inside out and lofts it over covers for a boundary.
Nazmul Islam is into the attack.
This one stays a touch low and it is bowled on middle, Williams gets his bat down in time and plays it towards mid on. 2 from the over, Mortaza is keeping it tight in his second spell.
Another length ball around off, it is pushed back towards the bowler who gets down and makes a half-stop.
Slightly ahead of a length around off, Williams strokes it to mid off.
Back of a length on off, Williams punches it to covers.
Fifty for Taylor. It has been a really good innings from him and it has come at a good pace also. He needs to carry on though. He flicks this through square leg and takes a single.
Slower ball on the pads, the batsman works it through square leg for a run.
This is driven through mid off for another single.
Strokes it through mid on for a run.
Fires this on the pads, Taylor nudges it fine on the leg side.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Trademark Taylor. It is a touch too full by Hasan and BT with a straight bat lofts it over the bowler's head and into the fence.
Flatter and around leg stump, Williams punches it down to long on for a single.
Floats it up on middle, the ball is pushed back to the bowler.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Full again in line, played with a straight bat.
Full on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Full on off, kept out.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Straighter ball on leg, hit to mid on.
Eases this down to long off for a run.

NOT OUT! Judicious use of the review! He had to take it right? Being the best batsman of the team, even if there is some doubt you need to go for it. Taylor did exactly that and he survives. This is tossed up around middle, turns back in. Taylor goes down on one knee and tries to sweep. He misses to get hit on the pads. The players make a long appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Taylor after a chat with his partner goes for the review. Replays show that the ball is missing the leg stump.
Taylor is a goner! A huge appeal for LBW has been given by the umpire. Taylor though has reviewed it.
The batsman tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Tosses it up around off, Taylor tries to go over mid off but gets an outside edge towards short third man.
Flatter and shorter in length on middle, the batter works it to mid-wicket.
Eases it down to long on and takes a run.
Tossed up on middle, it driven back to the bowler.

BEATEN! Mashrafe appeals but he is the only one doing so. This is fuller and outside off, angling back in. Taylor plays inside the line and the ball whizzes past the outside edge. Rahim takes it inches above the ground with a dive. The bowler appeals but nothing from the umpire. A good end to a good over.
Strays in line this time and bowls it on the pads, Williams flicks it through square leg for a run.
Good bowling this. The skipper is keeping it tight around the off stump channel giving nothing away. All Williams can do is play it out.
Good length on off, Williams guides it to point.
Back of a length delivery, Williams plays it with soft hands towards mid on for a run.
Good length around off, defended.
Slower through the air on off, it turns back in. Taylor tries to go over covers but due to the turn into him. The ball goes off the inner half through mid on for a run.
Slightly short and outside off, Williams cuts it through point for a run.
Attacks the stumps and Williams defends it. Two dots in a row.
Another loopy ball on off, it is worked to mid-wicket with the turn.
Tosses it up around off, the batter strokes it to covers.
Pushes it towards the man at mid off and takes a run.
A dot to end! On off, kept out.
Fuller but the line is a touch straighter, Taylor flicks it towards wide mid on for a run. Dealing in singles are Zimbabwe.

Direct hit needed, but the fielder misses. Would have been close that. Full and on off, Williams times it towards mid off and sets off for a run. The fielder there is quick to the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Lands it on a length once again but Williams opens the face of the bat and guides it towards point for a quick run.
Good length on middle, the batsman defends it onto the ground.
Drinks!
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.

EDGED BUT RUNS! No slip in place! This is fired outside off, Williams tries to play it late but the ball takes a thick outside edge, goes towards the third man fence but is stopped just before it crosses it. Two taken.
Another run as the batsman flicks it through mid-wicket.
Flatter around off, Williams punches it through covers and takes a run.
Another loopy ball around off, Williams pushes it to covers.
Tosses it up on off, the batsman with the turn plays it to covers.
A single to end! 6 runs in Mortaza's first over of his new spell. Length ball around off, it is pushed towards wide mid off.
Good length on the middle stump, Williams flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Tucks it with the angle through square leg for a run.
This time he forces it through covers and gets a run.

Comes from around the wicket to the left-hander and bowls it on a length and around off, Willams tries to force it through the off side but gets it off the inner half towards deep square leg. They run the first one hard and go for the second. Complete it with ease.
Angles this into the pads, the batsman works it through square leg and takes a single.
Mashrafe Mortaza is back on.
Full and on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a run.
On middle, flicked through the leg side for a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Outside off, pushed towards mid off.
Full on middle, pushed towards long on for a single.
Full and straight, pushed back to the bowler.
A bouncer, right at the head of the batsman, Williams ducks.
On a good length around middle, watchfully defended.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full on middle, played straight to short mid-wicket.
Outside off, played straight to point.

OUT! Holes out next ball! Full and on middle, Zhuwao goes for the big slog, but is not quite to the pitch of the ball. He gets a top edge which is calmly taken by Fazle Mahmud at long off. A bit of a slide from the fielder but calm enough. That is throwing away once's wicket. Here comes Sean Williams.
FOUR! Full and on middle, Zhuwao gets down and sweeps it over square leg for a boundary! THE 50-RUN STAND IS UP WITH THAT.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Full and outside off, chipped over cover for a single.
Pushes this towards long on for a single.
FOUR! SWEET! Full and outside off, Taylor uses his reach, gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it through mid off for a boundary!
Full toss outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Half volley outside off, Zhuwao looks to drive but gets an outside edge towards third man. Just a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. 4 fielders can now stand outside the circle till the 40th over.
FOUR! What an end to the Powerplay. Lofts this over mid off and the ball goes to the long off fence for a boundary. 15 from the over and Zimbabwe are 57/1 after 10 overs.
SIX! After two reverse sweeps he sweeps one and gets maximum from it. Gets low and swipes from outside off over square leg for a biggie.
Brings out the reverse sweep again but finds the man at backward point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR Byes! Give it to Taylor. Off spinner on off, Taylor looks to reverse sweep this one. Does not get any bat to it but the ball goes through the keeper and to the third man fence.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Mehidy Hasan to roll his arm.
Drags his length back a bit on off, Taylor punches it to covers.
FOUR! In total control this time. Much better from Taylor. Pitched up ball on off, Taylor drives it past covers for a delightful boundary.
FOUR! Lucky! Similar length on middle and off, Taylor closes the bat face early and gets an outside edge past the keeper. The ball runs to the third man fence.
Full again in line of the stumps, hit towards mid on to change ends.
Full down leg, flicked to square leg.

Short ball down leg, Zhuwao looks to hook it but the ball goes to the keeper. The Bangladeshi players put in an appeal but the umpire stays put. After a chat they opt against the review. Tell you what, the replays show us that there was faint spike when the ball past the glove. Bangladesh have missed a trick here.
No timing. A fuller ball has been driven straight to mid off. 3 runs off the Fizz's over.
Full in line, hit to mid-wicket.
Back of a length ball outside off, cut through point for one more.
Nice shot but again for one. Drives this fuller ball past covers. A good effort from the fielder keeps it to a single.
Driven through the covers by the batsman.
OUCH! NASTY! Short ball on off, CZ ducks to evade the ball but gets hit on his helmet. The ball rolls to the on side where they take a leg bye. Zhuwao is fine and is good to continue.
Double to end the over but still a good one from Saifuddin. Strays down leg, Taylor flicks it through mid-wicket to get a brace.
Full and outside off, driven to covers. 4 dots in a row.
Another dot. After getting 2 runs off the first ball, Zimbabwe should look to rotate the strike. Sees this full ball and Brendan hits it to the on side.
Full again this time on the pads of Taylor who hits it to mid on.
Full outside off, pushed to covers.
Full and down leg, Taylor flicks it through mid-wicket  in the gap. They pick up two runs easily.

SIX! First maximum of the innings. Nicely done from Zhuwao and that will give him a lot of confidence. Overpitched ball in line of the stumps, CZ clips this over mid-wicket. The ball goes high and just over the ropes for half a dozen.
Played to the mid-wicket region by Zhuwao.
Good running. Taylor plays this with soft hands towards mid-wicket and hares to the other end. The fielder there has a shy at the striker's end but doesn't hit the stumps.
Full down leg, flicked past square leg for one.
Oh! Almost! Rahman is troubling the batsmen here. Bowls this one on a good length around off, it comes back into the batsmen. CZ goes for the slog but the ball goes between his bat and pad.
Length ball outside off, punched to the off side.
Length ball on off, punched to covers. Superb start from Saifuddin, just a run and a wicket from his first over.
Brendan Taylor is in at no.3.

The bowling change has worked for Bangladesh. Saifuddin picks up a wicket in his very first over. Bowls this full and on the fourth stump line. Masakadza goes for the off drive but doesn't get to the pitch of the ball. The ball takes the outside edge of his bat and goes to Rahim who takes a regulation catch. Early blow for the visitors.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Goes fuller this time on leg, flicked away through square leg for a run.
Similar line and and almost like a replay of the previous ball. Stifled appeal which does down.
Back of a length ball on leg, Zhuwao misses his flick to get on his thigh pad.
First change of the innings. The skipper removes himself off the attack and gives Mohammad Saifuddin the ball.
Another good over from the Fizz. Fuller around off, Hamilton pushes it to covers. Just the single run from the over.
Back of a length ball outside off, Masakadza drives it to the off side.
Swing and miss. Perfect line and length from the Fizz. Off cutter outside off which keeps going away from Hamilton. The skipper goes for the drive and almost gets his outside to the keeper.
Full again outside off, Hamilton goes for the drive but cannot time it well. Hits it to the short cover fielder.
A bit full on that fourth stump channel, Masakadza taps it in front of him.
Back of a length ball outside off, cut past point to get off strike.
Mortaza hasn't got his line right. Errs down leg yet again, HM flicks it through mid-wicket. The ball doesn't go all the way but they manage to come back for the second.
Length ball around off, Hamilton gets behind the ball and bunts it out.
Similar line on leg, Masakadza once again stands tall and plays it to the leg side.
Length this time on leg, Masakadza works it to the on side.
FOUR! Fuller on the leg stump line, Masakadza shuffles and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Nicely done.
Angled down leg, Hamilton flicks it away past square leg. The timing is good and the running is even better as they pick up a couple of runs.
Good over from the Fizz. Bowls this outside off, HM opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single. Just the 2 runs from it.
Length ball on off, Masakadza bunts it down to the off side.

SHOT! But just for one. Pitched up ball in line of the stumps, Zhuwao smashes it hard over the bowler. However, the ball limps towards mid on. Replays show that it came off the inner half of the bat. Just a single.
CZ chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Swing and miss. Similar ball outside off, Zhuwao goes for the swing with no feet moment but cannot make contact.
Length ball outside off, Zhuwao shoulders his arms to it.
Mustafizur Rahman to bowl with the second new ball.
FOUR! Great shot to end the over. Power and Elegance all in one. Overpitched ball on off, Masakadza leans ahead and drives it through covers for a good looking boundary.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Great bowling. Length ball outside off, CZ goes for the booming drive but connects with thin air.
Strays down leg, Zhuwao tries flicking it away but cannot make any contact. No wide given by the umpire.
Length ball on middle and leg, Masakadza plays it with a straight bat to towards mid on for one.
Comes in from round the wicket and lands it full on off, Massakadza taps it to the off side.
We are ready. Hamilton Masakadza and Cephas Zhuwao to open for the hosts while Mashrafe Mortaza will bowl with the first new ball.

Hamilton Masakadza smiles and says that he would have batted first. Mentions that they need to get the small things right for long periods and keep wickets in hand. Ends saying there is one change to his team with Elton Chigumbura replacing Craig Ervine.

Mashrafe Mortaza says that there will be dew later on and so decides to field first. Mentions that the middle order came good in the first game and is not worried about the top order as they know what should be done. Mentions that he is happy with Saiffudin as he is an all-rounder and ends by saying that they are playing an unchanged XI.

Edward Rainsford doing the Pitch Report mentions that there is good covering of grass but it is dry out there. Reckons there are cracks all over but doesn't know if they will play a role. Says that the batsmen will have to work hard for their runs and adds saying 250-270 should be a good total. Ends by saying - win the toss, field first.
TOSS - Bangladesh win the toss and will field.

Zimbabwe have not tasted success in ODI format for a long time now. They had a good chance to win the first game and stamp their authority but they bottled it. After restricting the hosts half-way to a decent total they just couldn't apply the final nail to the coffin. All said and done, we're in Chittagong for the second ODI. Hello and welcome to our coverage of this game. The visitors should take some positives from the 1st game and come hard on the hosts right from the start. If they do, there is a high possibility they can be on the other side of the line. The hosts without their two main players, Tamim and Shakib, look a bit shaky and that was seen in the 1st game. Imrul Kayes saved them and they will hope someone takes the responsibility today. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.
